verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms a documented BILL v3 REST API covering AP/AR/S&E, transactions, budgets, virtual cards, and webhooks (developer.bill.com, llms.txt), supporting the core 'pull transactions/expenses' capability. However, no evidence explicitly documents OAuth flows, scoped token issuance, or receipt-specific endpoints, and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404s at all standard paths, weakening confirmation of API discoverability/auth details. missing for 10: explicit OAuth/auth documentation, scoped token details, receipt-specific endpoint evidence, working OpenAPI spec discovery.
